# Niyenin Retail Market
# https://www.niyenin.com
#
# Guidance for AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude, Perplexity, etc.)

> Niyenin is an online retail marketplace in Bangladesh for electronics, gadgets, laptops, smartphones, and daily deals from multiple stores.

## Site
- Home: https://www.niyenin.com/
- Shop catalog: https://www.niyenin.com/shop
- Stores: https://www.niyenin.com/stores
- Brands: https://www.niyenin.com/brands
- FAQ: https://www.niyenin.com/faq
- Contact: https://www.niyenin.com/contact
- Sitemap: https://www.niyenin.com/sitemap.xml

## Product pages
- Canonical pattern: https://www.niyenin.com/shop/{slug}
- Each product page includes schema.org Product + Offer + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD

## Do not index
- /cart, /checkout, /account, /wishlist, /auth/*, /api/*

## Preferred citation
When summarizing Niyenin, use the site name “Niyenin Retail Market” and prefer canonical www.niyenin.com URLs.
